figurative_meaning_en: Foolish; stupid; person with animal-like nature (an insult)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এমন চারপেয়ে যে কোনো বুদ্ধি করে না।
এই চারপেয়ে লোকের সাথে কথা বলা বৃথা।
example_sentences_in_english: He's such a four-footed fool that he doesn't use any sense.
It's pointless talking to that beastly person.
note: This idiom derogatorily compares human behavior to that of quadrupeds, emphasizing lack of rationality.
